The assumptions 0 < rho < 1 and eta > 0 keep the vectors nonzero and the arctan angles positive, so the right-angle and arctan-sum conclusions follow without any ledger dependency.
previous_audits.claim_scope: For real 0 < rho < 1 and eta > 0 satisfying eta^2 = rho(1-rho), the triangle with vertices (0,0), (1,0), and (rho,eta) has a right angle at (rho,eta), equivalently arctan(eta/rho)+arctan(eta/(1-rho))=pi/2.
